title: Pluperfect and other compound tenses
objectives: I can use the pluperfect (tinha feito) to place one past action before another.
I can form and use the future perfect (terei feito) and the conditional perfect (teria feito).
I can use the compound subjunctive tenses (tenha feito, tivesse feito, tiver feito) and build unreal past conditionals such as Se eu tivesse sabido, teria ido.
I can express regret and missed opportunities with devia ter, podia ter and se ao menos.
I can tell a life story or a sequence of historical events with a clear chronology.

example.pt: O maior arrependimento dele foi não ter viajado quando era jovem.
example.en: His greatest regret was not having traveled when he was young.

vocabulary.note: Followed by de: arrepender-se de algo. In speech: me arrependo.

example.pt: Eu me arrependo de não ter aprendido inglês mais cedo.
example.en: I regret not having learned English earlier.

vocabulary.en: to regret, to be sorry about
vocabulary.note: Lamento is also a polite way to say I am sorry to hear it.

example.pt: Lamento muito que você tenha perdido o emprego.
example.en: I am very sorry that you lost your job.

vocabulary.en: to take advantage of, to make the most of

example.pt: Ela aproveitou a viagem para conhecer os primos.
example.en: She took advantage of the trip to meet her cousins.

example.pt: Não quero desperdiçar essa oportunidade.
example.en: I don't want to waste this opportunity.

example.pt: A chuva forte teve consequências graves para a cidade.
example.en: The heavy rain had serious consequences for the city.

example.pt: A causa do acidente ainda não foi descoberta.
example.en: The cause of the accident has not been found yet.

example.pt: A falta de energia provocou um grande engarrafamento.
example.en: The power outage caused a huge traffic jam.

example.pt: O erro resultou em um prejuízo enorme para a empresa.
example.en: The mistake resulted in a huge loss for the company.

example.pt: Em consequência da greve, muitos voos foram cancelados.
example.en: As a result of the strike, many flights were canceled.

vocabulary.note: Ter culpa means to be at fault; a culpa é minha means it's my fault.

example.pt: A culpa não foi dele; ninguém tinha avisado sobre a mudança.
example.en: It wasn't his fault; nobody had told him about the change.

example.pt: Li uma biografia de Machado de Assis nas férias.
example.en: I read a biography of Machado de Assis during the vacation.

vocabulary.note: A respectful, formal alternative to morrer.

example.pt: O escritor faleceu aos oitenta anos, cercado pela família.
example.en: The writer passed away at eighty, surrounded by his family.

example.pt: Ele passou a infância numa cidade pequena do interior.
example.en: He spent his childhood in a small town in the interior.

example.pt: Na juventude, ela já sonhava em ser médica.
example.en: In her youth, she already dreamed of being a doctor.

example.pt: A trajetória da cantora começou num pequeno bar de Salvador.
example.en: The singer's path began in a small bar in Salvador.

example.pt: Depois de vinte anos de carreira, ele resolveu se aposentar.
example.en: After twenty years of career, he decided to retire.

example.pt: A construção de Brasília foi um marco na história do país.
example.en: The construction of Brasília was a milestone in the country's history.

vocabulary.note: Nessa época means at that time.

example.pt: Naquela época, poucas pessoas tinham telefone em casa.
example.en: At that time, few people had a telephone at home.

example.pt: Na década de sessenta, a música brasileira ganhou fama mundial.
example.en: In the nineteen sixties, Brazilian music gained worldwide fame.

example.pt: O café foi a base da economia no século dezenove.
example.en: Coffee was the basis of the economy in the nineteenth century.

example.pt: O Brasil foi um império até mil oitocentos e oitenta e nove.
example.en: Brazil was an empire until 1889.

example.pt: A abolição da escravidão aconteceu em mil oitocentos e oitenta e oito.
example.en: The abolition of slavery took place in 1888.

example.pt: A república foi proclamada no Brasil em mil oitocentos e oitenta e nove.
example.en: The republic was proclaimed in Brazil in 1889.

example.pt: A imigração italiana mudou a paisagem cultural de São Paulo.
example.en: Italian immigration changed the cultural landscape of São Paulo.

example.pt: O jornal publicou uma lista dos principais acontecimentos do ano.
example.en: The newspaper published a list of the year's main events.

example.pt: Em retrospecto, eu teria tomado outra decisão.
example.en: In retrospect, I would have made another decision.

vocabulary.note: Por pouco não plus verb means almost did.

example.pt: Por pouco não perdi o último trem.
example.en: I almost missed the last train.

vocabulary.en: thank goodness, it is a good thing that

example.pt: Ainda bem que você trouxe o guarda-chuva.
example.en: Thank goodness you brought the umbrella.

vocabulary.note: Followed by the imperfect or pluperfect subjunctive.

example.pt: Se ao menos eu tivesse perguntado antes!
example.en: If only I had asked earlier!

dialogues.title: If only I had...
dialogues.context: Two old friends, Fernanda and Ricardo, talk about missed opportunities over coffee.

lines.speaker: Ricardo
lines.pt: Fernanda, lembra do Henrique, nosso colega de faculdade? Ele abriu uma empresa em Portugal.
lines.en: Fernanda, do you remember Henrique, our college classmate? He started a company in Portugal.

lines.speaker: Fernanda
lines.pt: Sério? Quando a gente se formou, ele já tinha dito que ia tentar a sorte lá fora, mas ninguém acreditou.
lines.en: Really? When we graduated, he had already said he was going to try his luck abroad, but nobody believed him.

lines.speaker: Ricardo
lines.pt: Pois é. Às vezes eu penso que devia ter aceitado a proposta que recebi em Lisboa.
lines.en: Yes. Sometimes I think I should have accepted the offer I got in Lisbon.

lines.speaker: Fernanda
lines.pt: Você recebeu uma proposta? Eu não sabia disso!
lines.en: You got an offer? I didn't know that!

lines.speaker: Ricardo
lines.pt: Recebi, logo depois do mestrado. Mas minha filha tinha acabado de nascer, e a gente achou arriscado demais.
lines.en: I did, right after my master's. But my daughter had just been born, and we thought it was too risky.

lines.speaker: Fernanda
lines.pt: Entendo. Se você tivesse aceitado, provavelmente teria uma vida bem diferente hoje.
lines.en: I understand. If you had accepted, you would probably have a very different life today.

lines.speaker: Ricardo
lines.pt: Teria mesmo. Mas talvez eu não tivesse conhecido tanta gente boa aqui. É difícil saber.
lines.en: I would. But maybe I wouldn't have met so many good people here. It's hard to know.

lines.speaker: Fernanda
lines.pt: Eu também tenho os meus arrependimentos. Devia ter estudado piano quando era criança. Minha mãe insistiu tanto, e eu nunca quis.
lines.en: I have my regrets too. I should have studied piano as a child. My mother insisted so much, and I never wanted to.

lines.speaker: Ricardo
lines.pt: Nunca é tarde. Você podia começar agora.
lines.en: It's never too late. You could start now.

lines.speaker: Fernanda
lines.pt: Já pensei nisso. Até o fim do ano, quem sabe eu já tenha aprendido uma música inteira.
lines.en: I've thought about it. By the end of the year, maybe I'll have learned a whole song.

lines.speaker: Ricardo
lines.pt: Ótimo! E se eu tiver aprendido a cozinhar até lá, convido você pra jantar.
lines.en: Great! And if I've learned to cook by then, I'll invite you to dinner.

lines.speaker: Fernanda
lines.pt: Combinado! Ainda bem que a gente conversou.
lines.en: Deal! Thank goodness we talked.

dialogues.title: Interview with a writer
dialogues.context: Clara, a journalist, interviews the novelist Augusto about his life for a biography section in a magazine.

lines.speaker: Clara
lines.pt: Augusto, obrigada por nos receber. Vamos começar pela infância. Onde o senhor nasceu?
lines.en: Augusto, thank you for having us. Let's begin with your childhood. Where were you born?

lines.speaker: Augusto
lines.pt: Nasci em Recife, em mil novecentos e cinquenta e oito, numa família humilde. Meu pai era carpinteiro.
lines.en: I was born in Recife, in 1958, into a humble family. My father was a carpenter.

lines.speaker: Clara
lines.pt: Quando o senhor começou a escrever?
lines.en: When did you start writing?

lines.speaker: Augusto
lines.pt: Muito cedo. Aos dez anos eu já tinha escrito meu primeiro conto, num caderno de escola.
lines.en: Very early. At ten I had already written my first short story, in a school notebook.

lines.speaker: Clara
lines.pt: E como foi a juventude? O senhor saiu de casa cedo?
lines.en: And how was your youth? Did you leave home early?

lines.speaker: Augusto
lines.pt: Saí aos dezoito anos, para estudar em São Paulo. Quando cheguei, não conhecia ninguém e nunca tinha visto uma cidade tão grande.
lines.en: I left at eighteen, to study in São Paulo. When I arrived, I didn't know anyone and had never seen such a big city.

lines.speaker: Clara
lines.pt: Em que momento a sua carreira de escritor decolou?
lines.en: At what point did your writing career take off?

lines.speaker: Augusto
lines.pt: Em mil novecentos e oitenta e nove, quando ganhei um prêmio literário. Eu já tinha publicado dois livros, mas ninguém os havia lido.
lines.en: In 1989, when I won a literary prize. I had already published two books, but nobody had read them.

lines.speaker: Clara
lines.pt: Houve algum momento em que o senhor pensou em desistir?
lines.en: Was there a moment when you thought of giving up?

lines.speaker: Augusto
lines.pt: Vários. Se eu tivesse desistido depois do segundo livro, não teria chegado aonde cheguei.
lines.en: Several. If I had given up after the second book, I wouldn't have gotten where I did.

lines.speaker: Clara
lines.pt: O que o senhor diria ao jovem Augusto, se pudesse conversar com ele?
lines.en: What would you tell the young Augusto, if you could talk to him?

lines.speaker: Augusto
lines.pt: Diria: tenha paciência e leia muito. E aproveite cada oportunidade, porque algumas nunca voltam.
lines.en: I would say: be patient and read a lot. And take advantage of every opportunity, because some never come back.

dialogues.title: History class
dialogues.context: Professora Beatriz is building a timeline of the end of slavery and of the empire with two students, Lucas and Amanda.

lines.speaker: Beatriz
lines.pt: Hoje vamos organizar uma cronologia da abolição. Alguém lembra o ano da Lei Áurea?
lines.en: Today we are going to organize a chronology of abolition. Does anyone remember the year of the Golden Law?

lines.speaker: Lucas
lines.pt: Foi em mil oitocentos e oitenta e oito, professora.
lines.en: It was in 1888, professor.

lines.speaker: Beatriz
lines.pt: Correto. Quando a lei foi assinada, o imperador estava na Europa, e a princesa Isabel governava o país.
lines.en: Correct. When the law was signed, the emperor was in Europe, and Princess Isabel was ruling the country.

lines.speaker: Amanda
lines.pt: Mas a escravidão já tinha perdido muita força antes disso, né? Eu li sobre a Lei do Ventre Livre.
lines.en: But slavery had already lost a lot of strength before that, right? I read about the Law of the Free Womb.

lines.speaker: Beatriz
lines.pt: Isso. Essa lei, de mil oitocentos e setenta e um, já havia declarado livres os filhos de mulheres escravizadas nascidos depois dela.
lines.en: Right. That law, from 1871, had already declared free the children born after it to enslaved women.

lines.speaker: Lucas
lines.pt: E a república? Veio logo depois?
lines.en: And the republic? Did it come soon after?

lines.speaker: Beatriz
lines.pt: No ano seguinte, em mil oitocentos e oitenta e nove. Alguns historiadores se perguntam se o império teria durado mais, caso a abolição não tivesse acontecido.
lines.en: The following year, in 1889. Some historians wonder whether the empire would have lasted longer if abolition hadn't happened.

lines.speaker: Amanda
lines.pt: E a imigração? Também mudou muita coisa.
lines.en: And immigration? That changed a lot too.

lines.speaker: Beatriz
lines.pt: Mudou. Quando a escravidão terminou, milhares de imigrantes europeus já tinham chegado para trabalhar nas fazendas de café.
lines.en: It did. When slavery ended, thousands of European immigrants had already arrived to work on the coffee farms.

lines.speaker: Lucas
lines.pt: Então, em consequência da abolição e da imigração, a sociedade mudou bastante.
lines.en: So, as a result of abolition and immigration, society changed a lot.

lines.speaker: Beatriz
lines.pt: Exatamente. Cada acontecimento teve causas e consequências. Para a próxima aula, montem uma linha do tempo com as datas.
lines.en: Exactly. Each event had causes and consequences. For the next class, put together a timeline with the dates.

lines.speaker: Amanda
lines.pt: Por pouco eu não esqueci o caderno hoje. Ainda bem que lembrei.
lines.en: I almost forgot my notebook today. Thank goodness I remembered.

grammar.title: The pluperfect: tinha feito and fizera
grammar.explanation:
The compound pluperfect (mais-que-perfeito composto) is formed with ter in the imperfect plus the past participle: tinha falado, tinha feito, tinha ido. It places one past action before another past action or moment, exactly like English had done: Quando cheguei, o filme já tinha começado. The participle never changes when used with ter. It often appears with já (already), ainda não (not yet) and nunca (never): Eu nunca tinha visto o mar.

In more formal writing, haver replaces ter: Quando chegou, o filme já havia começado. There is also a simple pluperfect (mais-que-perfeito simples), formed from the third person plural of the preterite without -ram and adding -ra: falara, fizera, fora (from ser or ir), tivera, dissera. It is literary, found in novels, newspapers and formal history, and in a few fixed expressions, such as quem me dera. In conversation, it is replaced by tinha plus participle.

A common colloquial shortcut is to use the simple preterite when the order of events is already clear from the context: Quando eu cheguei, ele já saiu. Many native speakers prefer tinha saído in careful speech, and it is always safe in writing.

examples.pt: Quando o professor chegou, os alunos já tinham saído.
examples.en: When the teacher arrived, the students had already left.

examples.pt: Eu nunca tinha visto uma cidade tão grande.
examples.en: I had never seen such a big city.

examples.pt: Ela já havia publicado dois livros quando ganhou o prêmio.
examples.en: She had already published two books when she won the prize.

examples.pt: Ninguém sabia que ele fora professor na juventude.
examples.en: Nobody knew that he had been a teacher in his youth.

examples.pt: Nós tínhamos combinado de nos encontrar às oito, mas ele não apareceu.
examples.en: We had agreed to meet at eight, but he did not show up.

grammar.title: Future perfect and conditional perfect
grammar.explanation:
The future perfect (futuro do presente composto) is ter in the future plus the participle: terei feito, terás feito, terá feito, teremos feito, terão feito. It expresses an action that will be finished before a future moment: Até sexta, terei terminado o relatório. It can also express a conjecture about the past: Ele já terá chegado a esta hora (He has probably arrived by now). The form is formal. In everyday speech, people say vou ter terminado or simply já vou ter feito: Até sexta eu já vou ter terminado.

The conditional perfect (futuro do pretérito composto) is ter in the conditional plus the participle: teria feito, terias feito, teria feito, teríamos feito, teriam feito. It means would have done, and is the result clause of an unreal past condition: Se eu tivesse sabido, teria ido. In colloquial speech, the imperfect frequently replaces it: Se eu tivesse sabido, eu ia.

In journalism, the conditional perfect has a special function: it presents a fact as unconfirmed or reported by someone else. O ministro teria dito que vai renunciar means that the minister reportedly said that he would resign, but the newspaper does not vouch for it. Learn to recognize this use when you read the news.

rows: terei, terás, terá, teremos, terão + participle
teria, terias, teria, teríamos, teriam + participle
Eu teria ido, mas estava doente.
Até amanhã eu já vou ter terminado.
O prefeito teria aceitado a proposta.

examples.pt: Daqui a dez anos, eles já terão pago a casa.
examples.en: Ten years from now, they will have paid off the house.

examples.pt: Quando você acordar, eu já terei saído.
examples.en: By the time you wake up, I will have left.

examples.pt: Sem o seu apoio, eu não teria conseguido terminar.
examples.en: Without your support, I would not have managed to finish.

examples.pt: Ela teria viajado se a empresa tivesse dado férias.
examples.en: She would have traveled if the company had given her vacation.

examples.pt: Segundo a imprensa, o jogador teria assinado com outro clube.
examples.en: According to the press, the player would have signed with another club.

grammar.title: Compound subjunctive tenses and unreal past conditions
grammar.explanation:
Portuguese has three compound subjunctive tenses, each formed with ter in a subjunctive form plus the participle. The perfect subjunctive (tenha feito) refers to a completed action after triggers that require the subjunctive: Espero que ele tenha chegado, Duvido que ela tenha dito isso, É possível que eles tenham saído. The pluperfect subjunctive (tivesse feito) replaces the imperfect subjunctive when the situation is in the past: Se eu tivesse sabido, teria ido. The future perfect subjunctive (tiver feito) refers to an action that will be completed before another future moment: Assim que tiver terminado, eu te aviso.

Unreal past conditions use the pluperfect subjunctive in the if-clause and the conditional perfect in the result: Se ele tivesse estudado, teria passado (but he did not). The imperfect subjunctive with the ordinary conditional is for present or future hypotheses: Se eu tivesse tempo, viajaria mais. The two should not be mixed up. In speech, the result clause often uses the imperfect: Se eu tivesse sabido, eu ia.

The same tenses appear in wishes: Tomara que tenha dado certo (I hope it worked out), Quem me dera ter ido (if only I had gone), Se ao menos tivesse perguntado! Note that the triggers you already know (talvez, embora, não acho que, duvido que) accept compound subjunctives when the event is finished.

rows: Se eu tivesse estudado, teria passado.
Se eu tivesse podido, teria viajado.

examples.pt: Não acho que ele tenha entendido a pergunta.
examples.en: I don't think he understood the question.

examples.pt: Se eu tivesse acordado mais cedo, não teria perdido o voo.
examples.en: If I had woken up earlier, I would not have missed the flight.

examples.pt: Depois que vocês tiverem lido o texto, discutiremos o tema.
examples.en: After you have read the text, we will discuss the topic.

examples.pt: Quem me dera ter aprendido a tocar violão quando era criança.
examples.en: If only I had learned to play guitar as a child.

examples.pt: Embora tenha estudado muito, ela não passou na prova.
examples.en: Although she studied a lot, she did not pass the exam.

grammar.title: Regret, missed chances and the choice between ter and haver
grammar.explanation:
To express regret, the most natural constructions in speech are devia ter, deveria ter and podia ter plus participle: Eu devia ter estudado mais, Você podia ter avisado. These use the imperfect or conditional of dever and poder followed by the infinitive ter plus the participle, and they mean should have and could have. Other patterns are Se ao menos, Quem me dera, Que pena que, Lamento ter plus participle, Me arrependo de não ter plus participle, and Ainda bem que to express relief (Ainda bem que você veio!).

All the compound tenses in this unit can be formed with either of two auxiliaries, ter and haver. Ter is universal in speech and in most writing: tinha feito, terei feito, tenha feito. Haver is formal, archaic in tone, and common in newspapers, legal texts and literary works: havia feito, haverá feito, houvesse feito. In the present, haver is almost never used as an auxiliary in the modern language. There is no difference in meaning. Note that haver in the impersonal sense of there is or there was (havia, houve, haverá) is different and remains common.

To describe a life story or a sequence of historical events, mix the simple preterite for the main events with the pluperfect for what came before them. Use já, ainda, nunca, antes and depois to make the order clear: Em mil novecentos e seis, quando voou com o 14-Bis, ele já tinha construído vários balões.

rows: me arrependo de não ter + participle
Me arrependo de não ter ido.
Por pouco não perdi o trem.

examples.pt: Eu devia ter escutado o conselho da minha avó.
examples.en: I should have listened to my grandmother's advice.

examples.pt: Você poderia ter avisado que ia chegar tarde.
examples.en: You could have told me you were going to be late.

examples.pt: Lamento não ter aproveitado melhor a juventude.
examples.en: I regret not having made better use of my youth.

examples.pt: Por pouco não desperdiçamos a oportunidade.
examples.en: We almost wasted the opportunity.

examples.pt: Depois que haviam saído, o garçom percebeu que tinham esquecido a bolsa.
examples.en: After they had left, the waiter noticed that they had forgotten the bag.

culture.title: Arrependimento, saudade e a sabedoria dos provérbios
culture.text:
Brazilians have many sayings about regret and hindsight. Não adianta chorar o leite derramado means that it is useless to cry over spilled milk. Depois de casa roubada, trancas na porta is the local version of locking the barn door after the horse has gone. Água passada não move moinho says that water already past will not turn the mill, meaning that the past cannot be changed. Each one invites a verb in the compound tenses of this unit: Eu devia ter trancado a porta, Se ao menos tivesse ouvido.

A uniquely Brazilian word in this field is saudade, the mix of nostalgia and longing for a person, a place or a time. Songs, poems and everyday talk use it constantly: Que saudade daquela época! The pluperfect is natural here, because saudade looks back at a time that had already ended. Brazil is also a country of life stories: biographies of athletes, musicians and politicians sell well, and television programs often reconstruct a famous person's trajetória through family interviews.

The greatest Brazilian master of the literary past tenses is Machado de Assis, whose novel Memórias Póstumas de Brás Cubas, published in 1881, is narrated by a dead man who tells his life story with irony. In books like this one you will find the simple pluperfect (fora, dissera, tivera), which is now rare in speech. When you read Brazilian history, from the arrival of the royal court in 1808 to the republic in 1889, you will find chronology told with exactly the tenses studied here.

readings.title: Santos Dumont, o pai da aviação no Brasil

paragraphs.pt: Alberto Santos Dumont nasceu em mil oitocentos e setenta e três, numa fazenda de café de Minas Gerais. Desde criança, já tinha mostrado grande interesse por máquinas e sonhava com voar.
paragraphs.en: Alberto Santos Dumont was born in 1873 on a coffee farm in Minas Gerais. Since childhood, he had already shown great interest in machines and dreamed of flying.

paragraphs.pt: Em mil oitocentos e noventa e um, a família viajou para a França. Em Paris, ele logo fez os primeiros voos de balão e começou a construir seus próprios balões e dirigíveis.
paragraphs.en: In 1891, the family traveled to France. In Paris, he soon made his first balloon flights and began to build his own balloons and airships.

paragraphs.pt: Em mil novecentos e um, ganhou um prêmio ao contornar a Torre Eiffel com um dirigível. Depois desse feito, o mundo inteiro já conhecia o jovem brasileiro que voava sobre Paris.
paragraphs.en: In 1901, he won a prize by flying an airship around the Eiffel Tower. After that feat, the whole world already knew the young Brazilian who flew over Paris.

paragraphs.pt: Quando levantou voo com o Quatorze Bis, em mil novecentos e seis, Santos Dumont já tinha construído mais de uma dezena de balões e dirigíveis e acumulado anos de experiência.
paragraphs.en: When he took off in the 14-Bis, in 1906, Santos Dumont had already built more than a dozen balloons and airships and had accumulated years of experience.

paragraphs.pt: O avião voou algumas dezenas de metros diante de uma multidão e, em consequência desse voo, o nome dele entrou para a história da aviação. Semanas depois, outro voo foi ainda mais longo.
paragraphs.en: The airplane flew a few dozen meters in front of a crowd and, as a result of that flight, his name entered the history of aviation. Weeks later, another flight was even longer.

paragraphs.pt: Em mil novecentos e nove, apresentou o Demoiselle, um avião pequeno e leve. Ele nunca patenteou suas invenções, porque achava que elas deviam servir a todos.
paragraphs.en: In 1909, he presented the Demoiselle, a small and light airplane. He never patented his inventions, because he thought they should serve everyone.

paragraphs.pt: Santos Dumont faleceu em mil novecentos e trinta e dois, no Guarujá. Até hoje, muitos brasileiros o consideram o pai da aviação, embora outros países defendam versões diferentes dessa história.
paragraphs.en: Santos Dumont died in 1932, in Guarujá. To this day, many Brazilians consider him the father of aviation, although other countries defend different versions of this story.

questions.prompt: What prize did Santos Dumont win in 1901?
choices: For flying an airship around the Eiffel Tower
questions.explanation: The text says he won a prize ao contornar a Torre Eiffel com um dirigível.

questions.prompt: What had he done before the 14-Bis flight in 1906?
choices: He had built more than a dozen balloons and airships
He had patented all his inventions
He had taught aviation in Brazil
questions.explanation: He já tinha construído mais de uma dezena de balões e dirigíveis.

questions.prompt: Why didn't Santos Dumont patent his inventions?
choices: He did not know about patents
He thought they should serve everyone
questions.explanation: He achava que elas deviam servir a todos.

questions.prompt: What does the last paragraph say about his legacy?
choices: Many Brazilians consider him the father of aviation, though other countries tell different versions
He is remembered only in France
questions.explanation: The text says that other countries defendem versões diferentes dessa história.

readings.title: Carta ao Daniel de vinte anos

paragraphs.pt: Caro Daniel, hoje, com quarenta anos, releio o caderno em que você escrevia seus planos. Muita coisa que você sonhou aconteceu. Outras, nem tanto, e eu gostaria de ter conversado com você antes.
paragraphs.en: Dear Daniel, today, at forty, I reread the notebook in which you wrote your plans. Many things you dreamed of came true. Others, not so much, and I wish I had talked to you earlier.

paragraphs.pt: Eu devia ter estudado música com mais seriedade. Quando o professor Jorge me ofereceu uma bolsa, eu já tinha decidido fazer engenharia, e hoje penso que teria sido feliz tocando piano.
paragraphs.en: I should have studied music more seriously. When Professor Jorge offered me a scholarship, I had already decided on engineering, and today I think I would have been happy playing the piano.

paragraphs.pt: Se eu tivesse aceitado a bolsa, teria viajado para a Europa aos vinte e dois anos. Talvez tivesse conhecido pessoas que mudariam a minha vida, mas não posso ter certeza de nada.
paragraphs.en: If I had accepted the scholarship, I would have traveled to Europe at twenty-two. Perhaps I would have met people who would change my life, but I cannot be sure of anything.

paragraphs.pt: Em retrospecto, o maior erro não foi uma escolha, e sim o medo. Por pouco não desisti do curso de engenharia, e ainda bem que continuei, porque foi lá que conheci a Marta.
paragraphs.en: In retrospect, the biggest mistake was not a choice, but fear. I almost dropped out of the engineering course, and thank goodness I continued, because that is where I met Marta.

paragraphs.pt: Quando nos casamos, eu ainda não tinha aprendido a dizer o que sentia. Lamento ter demorado tanto. Se tivesse falado antes, teríamos evitado muitas discussões inúteis.
paragraphs.en: When we got married, I had not yet learned to say what I felt. I regret having taken so long. If I had spoken earlier, we would have avoided many useless arguments.

paragraphs.pt: Não me arrependo de tudo. Aprendi que quem nunca errou talvez nunca tenha tentado. Espero que você, ao ler estas linhas, tenha coragem de arriscar mais do que eu arrisquei.
paragraphs.en: I do not regret everything. I learned that whoever has never made a mistake has perhaps never tried. I hope that you, when you read these lines, have the courage to risk more than I risked.

paragraphs.pt: Até os cinquenta anos, terei terminado o curso de música que deixei de lado. Será a minha maneira de cumprir, com atraso, a promessa que fiz a você.
paragraphs.en: By fifty, I will have finished the music course that I set aside. It will be my way of fulfilling, late, the promise I made to you.

questions.prompt: What does the narrator regret the most?
choices: Not having accepted the music scholarship
questions.explanation: He says he devia ter estudado música and did not accept the bolsa.

questions.prompt: Why is he glad he did not drop out of the engineering course?
choices: He got a good job there
questions.explanation: Foi lá que conheci a Marta.

questions.prompt: What does he say was the biggest mistake?
questions.explanation: O maior erro não foi uma escolha, e sim o medo.

questions.prompt: What does he promise to do by the age of fifty?
questions.explanation: Até os cinquenta anos, terei terminado o curso de música.

exercises.prompt: Complete: Quando cheguei ao cinema, o filme já ___.
exercises.explanation: The pluperfect places the beginning of the film before my arrival.
Devia ter plus participle means should have.

exercises.prompt: Complete the unreal past condition: Se ela tivesse estudado, ___ na prova.
exercises.explanation: The pluperfect subjunctive is followed by the conditional perfect.
Ter in the future plus a participle makes the future perfect.

exercises.prompt: In a news story, 'O ministro teria dito que vai renunciar' suggests that...
choices: it was reported but is not confirmed
exercises.explanation: The conditional perfect is used in journalism for unconfirmed information.

exercises.prompt: Which sentence uses the simple pluperfect, mostly found in literary writing?
choices: Ele fora embora antes do jantar.
Ele tinha ido embora antes do jantar.
Ele foi embora antes do jantar.
Ele ia embora antes do jantar.
exercises.explanation: Fora is the simple pluperfect of ir and ser.

exercises.prompt_pt: Quando ele chegou, nós já ___ jantado.
exercises.hint_en: When he arrived, we had already had dinner.
exercises.explanation: Ter or haver in the imperfect plus the participle.
Devia ter plus participle expresses regret.

exercises.hint_en: I hope she has arrived safely.
exercises.explanation: The perfect subjunctive follows espero que.

exercises.prompt_pt: Se eu ___ estudado mais, teria passado.
exercises.hint_en: If I had studied more, I would have passed.
exercises.explanation: The pluperfect subjunctive in the if-clause of an unreal past condition.

exercises.prompt_pt: Até o fim do ano, eu ___ terminado a faculdade.
exercises.hint_en: By the end of the year, I will have finished college.
exercises.explanation: The future perfect, or the colloquial vou ter plus participle.

exercises.prompt_pt: Ela ___ ido ao show, mas estava doente.
exercises.hint_en: She would have gone to the concert, but she was sick.
exercises.explanation: The conditional perfect expresses would have.

exercises.prompt_pt: Assim que eu ___ terminado o trabalho, te ligo.
exercises.hint_en: As soon as I have finished the work, I'll call you.
exercises.explanation: Assim que takes the future subjunctive, here compound.

exercises.prompt_pt: Ainda ___ que você chegou a tempo.
exercises.hint_en: Thank goodness you arrived on time.
exercises.explanation: Ainda bem que is a fixed expression of relief.

exercises.prompt_en: When I arrived, the film had already started.
answers: Quando cheguei, o filme já tinha começado.
Quando eu cheguei, o filme já tinha começado.
Quando cheguei, o filme já havia começado.
Quando eu cheguei, o filme já havia começado.

exercises.prompt_en: If I had known, I would have gone.
answers: Se eu tivesse sabido, teria ido.
Se eu tivesse sabido, eu teria ido.
Eu devia ter ligado para você.
Eu deveria ter ligado para você.
Eu devia ter ligado pra você.
Eu deveria ter ligado pra você.
Eu espero que ele tenha chegado.

exercises.prompt_en: When we arrived, he had already left.
If I had studied, I would have passed.
I should have told the truth.
He had already published two books.

exercises.audio_pt: Quando cheguei, ele já tinha saído.
choices: When I arrived, he was leaving.
When I arrived, he had already left.
When I arrive, he will have left.

exercises.audio_pt: Se eu tivesse sabido, teria ido.
choices: If I knew, I would go.
If I know, I will go.

exercises.audio_pt: Ainda bem que ele chegou a tempo.
choices: Thank goodness he arrived on time.

exercises.audio_pt: Eu nunca tinha visto o mar.
exercises.hint_en: I had never seen the sea.

exercises.audio_pt: Se eu tivesse saído cedo, teria chegado a tempo.
exercises.hint_en: If I had left early, I would have arrived on time.

exercises.audio_pt: Espero que ele tenha chegado bem.
exercises.hint_en: I hope he has arrived safely.
